prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin to establish rules for [finish, new_flow], [finish, new_screen], [sign_in, notification], and [sign_in, reorder] since each kind of change has only one test so far.
Evidence for [adoption, new_flow] and [adoption, new_screen] remains mixed: for each, one test won while the other showed no clear effect.
Evidence for [adoption, redesign] remains inconclusive across three tests: one stopped early (-8.4% after noise correction), one showed no clear effect (+0.7%), and one won (+5.5%).
[finish, redesign] changes tend to be helpful, as two of four tests won (+5.5% and +4.3% after noise correction), while two showed no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently too low for all winning tests across all rounds.
Predictions were usually too high for tests that stopped early or showed no clear effect, with round 11 as the sole exception.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +2.5% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, new_screen: +1.9% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: +0.0% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- finish, new_flow: +10.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -6.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: +2.1% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- sign_in, notification: +1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -8.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 74.0%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 83.7%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 28.0%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Finish Screen Companion Interaction Cheat Sheet Layout: Redesigns the finish welcome screen into a card-style interaction guide showing how to summon, minimize, and chat with the pet on desktop. (why: Support emails show post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Pet Personality Selection and Trait Studio: Redesigns pet selection into a stage layout where users pick companion trait profiles before adoption. (why: Adoption stage has a 74.0% conversion rate with 89s median time, and support logs show issues with pet customization.)
2: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Pet Generation Progress Hints: Displays estimated wait time and helpful tips while the app prepares the desktop pet space. (why: The home stage has a long median wait duration of 201s and mean of 2336s.)
3: [choose_path, redesign] Story Welcome Exploration Stage Layout: Rebuilds the story intro screen into a full-bleed visual layout setting up the companion journey. (why: The choose_path step has a 76.2% conversion rate and a high mean duration of 514s.)
4: [sign_in, layout] Sign In Account Safety and Sync Layout: Updates sign-in screen layout to emphasize automatic cloud sync and account data preservation. (why: Top support issue (8 emails) reported missing or reset pets after signing back in.)
5: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Companion Quick Shortcut Guide Screen: Adds a final screen listing desktop key shortcuts for controlling and hiding the desktop pet. (why: Multiple support tickets expressed confusion over controlling or hiding the pet post-onboarding.)
6: [adoption, new_flow] Custom Photo Verification and Preview Flow: Introduces step counter and multi-step progress indicators during custom photo upload for companion creation. (why: Support mail noted custom pet generation failing or producing unexpected visual results.)
7: [choose_path, hint] Choose Path Quick Start Selection Hint: Adds explicit path duration hints and guidance on quick vs custom setup. (why: Users take an average of 514s on path selection; clear hints reduce decision paralysis.)
8: [sign_in, copy] Sign In Cloud Save Guarantee Copy: Clarifies in the body copy that signing in prevents pet loss and protects pet save files. (why: Addresses 8 support tickets where users reported losing pets after signing back in.)

scores.note: Finish step has lower dropoff (16.3%), but redesigns on finish have strong positive precedent (+2.1% avg).
Adoption step loses 26.0% of users, but adoption redesigns show mixed/inconclusive historical results.

Adding new screens to finish step previously reduced conversion (-6.8%) by adding friction.
Solves reported upload issues in adoption step; adoption new_flow has mixed past results (+2.5% avg).
Config-only hint addressing high duration (514s) on choose_path with minimal implementation effort.
Config-only copy fix directly tackling the top support issue (8 emails) on the highest-drop step.
